source.titleEnglishInternal: Email the Hotel a Written Incident Summary
source.objectiveEnglishInternal: Write a clear, formal summary of the incident and your requests, sharing only the health details Lucía approved.
source.speakingEnglishInternal: You are drafting the email to Inés Soler, and the AI is Lucía, your friend: read your summary aloud, check which health details she approves, and organize it with en primer lugar, a continuación, sin embargo, por lo tanto and por último.
grammarEnglishExamplesInternal: First, my friend had an allergic reaction during breakfast.
However, no one told us the ingredients; therefore, we request a review.

readerVerbExamples.target: Le escribo en relación con lo ocurrido el martes.
readerVerbExamples.native: I am writing to you regarding what happened on Tuesday.

readerVerbExamples.target: Lucía, ¿te parece bien si menciono que fuiste a urgencias?
readerVerbExamples.native: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?

readerVerbExamples.target: A continuación, resumo brevemente lo que ocurrió durante el desayuno.
readerVerbExamples.native: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.

readerVerbExamples.target: Por lo tanto, les solicito una respuesta por escrito.
readerVerbExamples.native: Therefore, I request a written reply from you.

readerVerbExamples.target: Adjunto una copia de la hoja de reclamaciones.
readerVerbExamples.native: I am attaching a copy of the official complaint form.

archivedDraft.scene: A traveler reads a draft incident email aloud to the affected friend and revises it to match the friend's disclosure choices.

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Spain usage; much of Latin America says la estadía.
Spain: businesses must provide this form on request.
Standard formal sign-off before your name.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Estimada señora Soler: le escribo en relación con lo ocurrido el martes.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Formal. Spanish emails put a colon, not a comma, after the greeting.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ソレル様：火曜日に起きた件についてご連絡いたします。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: En primer lugar, quisiera agradecer la rápida atención de su personal.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: まず、スタッフの迅速な対応に感謝申し上げます。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: A continuación, resumo brevemente lo que ocurrió durante el desayuno.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 以下に、朝食中に起きたことを簡潔にまとめます。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Sin embargo, la carta de alérgenos no estaba a la vista.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: However, the allergen menu was not on display.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: しかし、アレルゲン一覧は掲示されていませんでした。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: However, the allergen menu was not on display.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Por lo tanto, les solicito una respuesta por escrito sobre lo sucedido.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: そのため、今回の件について書面での回答をお願いいたします。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Por último, quedo a la espera de su respuesta.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Finally, I look forward to your reply.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 最後に、ご返信をお待ちしております。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Finally, I look forward to your reply.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Lucía, ¿te parece bien si menciono que fuiste a urgencias?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシア、救急外来に行ったことを書いてもいい？
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: No pondré nada del informe médico sin tu permiso.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: あなたの許可なく医療報告書の内容は一切書かないよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En su habitación del hotel de Valencia, Emma escribe el resumen del incidente para Inés Soler, responsable de atención al cliente.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: In her room at the hotel in Valencia, Emma writes the summary of the incident for Inés Soler, the customer service manager.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: バレンシアのホテルの自室で、エマは顧客対応責任者のイネス・ソレルに宛てて、今回の出来事の要約を書いています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: In her room at the hotel in Valencia, Emma writes the summary of the incident for Inés Soler, the customer service manager.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En el asunto pone: Reacción alérgica en el desayuno del martes 13 de octubre.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: In the subject line she puts: Allergic reaction at breakfast on Tuesday, October 13.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 件名には「10月13日火曜日の朝食時のアレルギー反応」と書きます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: In the subject line she puts: Allergic reaction at breakfast on Tuesday, October 13.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía, su amiga, está sentada en la cama y decide qué datos de salud quiere compartir con el hotel.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía, her friend, is sitting on the bed and decides which health information she wants to share with the hotel.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 友人のルシアはベッドに座り、ホテルにどの健康情報を伝えるかを自分で決めています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Lucía, her friend, is sitting on the bed and decides which health information she wants to share with the hotel.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: Lucía, ¿te parece bien si menciono que fuiste a urgencias?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：ルシア、救急外来に行ったことを書いてもいい？
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Emma: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Lucía
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía: Sí, pero no menciones el diagnóstico ni los medicamentos, por favor.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía: Yes, but don't mention the diagnosis or the medications, please.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシア：うん。でも診断名や薬のことは書かないでね。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Lucía: Yes, but don't mention the diagnosis or the medications, please.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: No pondré nada del informe médico sin tu permiso.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：あなたの許可なく医療報告書の内容は一切書かないよ。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Emma: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Para Lucía, la confidencialidad es importante, así que su consentimiento solo cubre la alergia a la almendra y la visita a urgencias.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: For Lucía, confidentiality is important, so her consent only covers the almond allergy and the visit to the ER.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシアにとって秘密保持は大切です。そのため、彼女が同意したのはアーモンドアレルギーと救急外来を受診したことだけです。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: For Lucía, confidentiality is important, so her consent only covers the almond allergy and the visit to the ER.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Estimada señora Soler: le escribo en relación con lo ocurrido el martes.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ソレル様：火曜日に起きた件についてご連絡いたします。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En primer lugar, quisiera agradecer la rápida atención de su personal.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: まず、スタッフの迅速な対応に感謝申し上げます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: A continuación, resumo brevemente lo que ocurrió durante el desayuno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 以下に、朝食中に起きたことを簡潔にまとめます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Durante nuestra estancia, mi amiga comió un bizcocho con almendra, tuvo una reacción alérgica y fue a urgencias.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: During our stay, my friend ate a sponge cake with almond, had an allergic reaction and went to the ER.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 滞在中、友人はアーモンド入りのスポンジケーキを食べ、アレルギー反応を起こして救急外来に行きました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: During our stay, my friend ate a sponge cake with almond, had an allergic reaction and went to the ER.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sin embargo, la carta de alérgenos no estaba a la vista.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: However, the allergen menu was not on display.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: しかし、アレルゲン一覧は掲示されていませんでした。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: However, the allergen menu was not on display.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Por lo tanto, les solicito una respuesta por escrito sobre lo sucedido.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: そのため、今回の件について書面での回答をお願いいたします。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: También les pido una disculpa y una revisión de la carta de alérgenos en un plazo de 15 días.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I also ask for an apology and a review of the allergen menu within a time frame of 15 days.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: また、15日以内に謝罪とアレルゲン一覧の見直しをお願いいたします。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I also ask for an apology and a review of the allergen menu within a time frame of 15 days.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Adjunto una copia de la hoja de reclamaciones que rellenamos en recepción.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I am attaching a copy of the official complaint form that we filled out at the front desk.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: フロントで記入した正式な苦情申立書の写しを添付します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I am attaching a copy of the official complaint form that we filled out at the front desk.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Por último, quedo a la espera de su respuesta.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Finally, I look forward to your reply.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 最後に、ご返信をお待ちしております。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Finally, I look forward to your reply.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Antes de enviar el correo, Emma revisa el archivo adjunto y confirma que no incluye el informe médico.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Before sending the email, Emma checks the attachment and confirms that it does not include the medical report.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: メールを送る前に、エマは添付ファイルを確認し、医療報告書が含まれていないことを確かめます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Before sending the email, Emma checks the attachment and confirms that it does not include the medical report.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Para la despedida, Emma escribe: Atentamente, Emma Clarke.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: For the sign-off, Emma writes: Sincerely, Emma Clarke.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 結びの挨拶として、エマは「敬具、エマ・クラーク」と書きます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: For the sign-off, Emma writes: Sincerely, Emma Clarke.

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: Organize a formal Japanese email and ask Lucía which health details she permits sharing before sending it.
speakingGoalInternal: You are drafting the email to Inés Soler, and the AI is Lucía, your friend: read your summary aloud, check which health details she approves, and organize it with en primer lugar, a continuación, sin embargo, por lo tanto and por último.
speakingGoalJapaneseDraft: あなたはイネス・ソレル宛てのメールを書いているエマで、相手は友人のルシアです。事件の要約を読み上げ、ルシアがどの健康情報の共有に同意するか確認し、「まず」「以下に」「しかし」「そのため」「最後に」で順序立てて伝えます。診断名と薬は含めません。
sourceConflictInternal: The current Valencia source is a 24-card, 18-turn consent-limited email to Inés Soler. The archived generic draft omits the dated subject line, almond cake, exact disclosure choices, official complaint attachment, 15-day request, and Emma's final attachment check. It remains separate evidence.

savedPositionPolicy: Archived draft rows have no explicit stable row IDs and were not registered. Revision-scoped candidate IDs do not authorize saved-item or audio placement migration. Reordering requires a new revision.
reviewQuestionsInternal: Spanish source addresses Inés Soler with Estimada señora Soler and a colon; Japanese ソレル様 is an adaptation of the formal address, not an exact punctuation transfer.
Source distinguishes Lucía's consent to disclose almond allergy and ER visit from her refusal to share diagnosis and medications; no medical report is attached.
Medical report, diagnosis, medication, confidentiality and consent terminology need qualified Japanese and clinical review without euphemizing the source.
The current source asks for an apology and allergen-menu review within 15 days; Japanese request register and its relation to Spanish official complaint procedure need qualified locale review.
Spanish carta de alérgenos may be an allergen menu/list; Japanese アレルゲン一覧 requires food-service and dictionary review.
Spanish formal email closure atentamente is adapted here as 敬具; qualified Japanese register review should decide the best email-specific equivalent.
The archived generic 16-card/10-turn email draft differs from the current 24-card/18-turn Valencia source; no saved-item or audio migration is authorized.
Six authored mode prompt/answer pairs, source-aligned forms and speaking setup, dictionary senses, exact-text audio and per-clip listening remain open.
